products.body:
Metric 08B stainless steel roller chain is one of the most commonly used metric chain sizes worldwide. Our high-quality 08B stainless roller chain is manufactured from top-tier 304-grade stainless, utilizes precision components, and has undergone factory pre-loading. Combining these creates an 08BSS chain with superior performance, lifespan, and corrosion resistance. Our 08B stainless steel roller chain is commonly found in food processing, packaging, marine environments, bottling, and more applications! This 12.7mm (1/2") pitch chain is highly versatile and conforms dimensionally to ISO and British Standards (BS) for direct interchangeability with other brands. For additional information or a quote on our superior 08B stainless steel roller chain, contact our customer support team, and we will gladly assist you!

08B Stainless Roller Chain Dimensions


  • Part #: 08BSS
  • Pitch (P): 12.70mm
  • Roller Width (R): 7.75mm
  • Roller Diameter (D): 8.51mm
  • Overall Width (W): 17.00mm
  • Connecting Link Overall Width (X): 20.90mm
  • Plate Height (H): 11.56mm
  • Plate Thickness (T): 1.58mm
  • Pin Diameter (L): 4.44mm
  • Weight: 0.7 kG/ m

products.body: 08B stainless steel offset link consists of a roller, two offset side plates, a bushing, and one pin that is retained by a cotter key. Our high-quality 08B stainless steel offset link is precision manufactured from 304-grade stainless steel, allowing it to operate within food-grade, corrosive, and abrasive environments. Additionally, it dimensionally conforms to ISO and BS standards. For more information or a quote on our 08B stainless offset links, contact our customer support team, and we will gladly assist you!

products.body: Our 08B stainless steel connecting link is a precision link made from premium 304-grade stainless steel that conforms to ISO and BS Standards. 08B stainless steel connecting links are also called 08B stainless steel mater links and connect two chain sections. Our 08B stainless steel connecting link utilizes a spring clip for link retanage and directly interchanges with other brands. For additional information or to get a quote on our 08B stainless connecting links, contact our customer service team, and we will gladly assist you!
